title: My Entry for the AI Game Browser Jam
author: CocolitoCollective
selftext:
Here's my submission for the [AI Browser Game Jam 3](https://itch.io/jam/ai-game-jam-3) \- 

  
[Familiar Frenzy](https://mrcanela.itch.io/familiar-frenzy) 

  
This is the first time I joined a Game Jam and I'm quite happy with the results. It's a Survivor-like game similar to Vampire Survivors (not as good as it obviously!) 

  
I used ChatGPT to help me Prompt and create Mock-up ideas. 

Claude Opus 4.8 (and a little of Fable 5 RIP) for the coding aspect.

[PixelLab.ai](http://PixelLab.ai) for asset generation & Aseprite for manual editing sprites/animations. 

Songs by [ELVGames](https://elvgames.itch.io/). 

  
I still have a few days before the Jam ends so I will keep updating it. I'm happy with it and still have things to improve.

comments.author: Yenii_3025
comments.body:
\- Art constinstency is imressive  
\- Having no access to mouse feels bad  
\- When I expand to full screen on chrome it doesn't zoom in  
\- Needs more sound. Oooo purring on level up would be cute  
\- Idk why but I'm loving the bare bones tutorial notifications that isn't intrusive but just gives a little heads up.
